newsitem.title: UK: BOE gives UK money market 136 mln stg further help.
newsitem.headline: BOE gives UK money market 136 mln stg further help.

text.p: The Bank of England said it provided the UK money market with a further 136 million stg of assistance at established interest rates.
The Bank allotted 92 million stg outright in bills maturing on or before May 27 and 44 million stg in repos to May 27.
It has now provided liquidity totalling 689 million stg so far on Tuesday, in response to a forecast money market shortage of 900 million stg.
